title: Sunlit Gouache
description: Un style d'illustration vibrant et ensoleillé rappelant l'esthétique City Pop japonaise des années 1980. Il se caractérise par des aplats de couleurs opaques, des ombres portées nettes et une absence totale de contours ou de dégradés, offrant un rendu vectoriel graphique, net et tranquille.
description_en: A vibrant, sun-drenched illustration style reminiscent of 1980s Japanese City Pop aesthetics. It features flat, opaque color blocking, razor-sharp cast shadows, and a complete absence of outlines or gradients, resulting in a crisp, tranquil, and highly graphic vector-like finish.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration vibrant et ensoleillé rappelant l'esthétique City Pop japonaise des années 1980. Il se caractérise par des aplats de couleurs opaques, des ombres portées nettes et une absence totale de contours ou de dégradés, offrant un rendu vectoriel graphique, net et tranquille.
prompt: Digital vector illustration mimicking traditional opaque gouache painting, reminiscent of 1980s Japanese City Pop album aesthetics. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, full bleed to all four corners. Employ harsh, direct midday sunlight to create stark, high-contrast lighting dynamics. Utilize flat, highly saturated opaque color blocking dominated by {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}, punctuated by vivid {{accent_color}} focal points. Cast shadows must be deep, cool-toned, and feature razor-sharp, hard geometric edges. Completely omit outlines, line work, soft shading, and gradients; forms and spatial depth must be defined exclusively by crisp, unblended high-contrast color boundaries. The texture is a pristine, ultra-smooth matte finish devoid of noise, grain, or brushstrokes. Edges of all elements must behave as clean, vector-cut silhouettes.
